summary: Core deflate compression loop over a zlib-style state object. Refills input via TextBufferDecompressor when the available byte count drops below 262, inserts each byte into a hash chain, finds the longest LZ77 match via ZlibDeflateLongestMatch, and emits either a literal byte or a length/distance pair while updating frequency tables. HuffmanBitStreamEncoder flushes buffered symbols and BufferCopyWithSizeTracking drains the output stream whenever the pending buffer reaches its limit.

local_names.a2: flush flag (nonzero forces final flush; equal to 4 for the end-of-block marker)

operations.description: Outer while(1) loop consumes one input symbol (literal or length/distance match) per iteration until input is exhausted or a flush/buffer-full exit fires.
When the available byte count at a1+106 drops below 262, call TextBufferDecompressor(a1) to refill the input buffer.
After a refill, if the count is still below 262 and the flush flag a2 is zero, return 0 (need more input); if the count reaches zero, break the loop.
When the count is at least 3, compute the hash key v7 = state at a1+74 AND (input byte at a1+46 + pos + 2 XOR (previous hash at a1+62 shifted left by a1+78)) for hash-chain insertion.
Store the hash-chain entry: write the previous chain value at a1+54 + 2*(pos AND a1+42), store the current position word at a1+58 + 2*new_hash, and update the hash state at a1+62.
If a chain entry v3 exists, the position is within the window (pos - v3 <= a1+34 - 262), and the mode at a1+126 is not 2, call ZlibDeflateLongestMatch(a1, v3) to extend the match.
If the match length at a1+86 is below 3, take the literal path: read one input byte, emit it to the output byte stream, and bump its literal-frequency counter.

Match path: compute distance = pos at a1+98 minus previous offset at a1+102, emit a length byte of match_len - 3, and update the length/distance frequency tables using the lookup tables byte_5B84F8, byte_5B83F8 and byte_5B82F8.
Inner do-while loop continues hash-chain insertion per consumed byte while the match length counter at a1+86 is decremented toward zero.

When the pending output buffer is full (pending count at a1+5779 equals the limit at a1+5775 minus 1), flush via HuffmanBitStreamEncoder(count, 0) and drain the output stream object with BufferCopyWithSizeTracking; return 0 if the stream reports full.
On loop exit, perform the final flush: HuffmanBitStreamEncoder(pending count, a2 == 4) followed by BufferCopyWithSizeTracking(v29) on the output stream.
Return code from the set 0, 1, 2, 3 encoding flush status: 0 when more input is needed or the output stream is full, otherwise 1 + 2*(a2 == 4) when the stream is still writable.

clean_pseudocode: int match = ZlibDeflateLongestMatch(state, chain);  // if chain && in-window && mode != 2
unresolved: Canonical/ABI names describe this as inflate/decompression, but the raw code performs deflate COMPRESSION: hash-chain insertion, longest-match search, and length/distance emission. Naming discrepancy is unresolved.
The many state offsets (106, 98, 62, 74, 78, 46, 34, 118, 126, 82, 86, 102, 138, 1166, 2430, 5771, 5775, 5779, 5783) are treated as opaque; the packet provides no field evidence refs for them.
The exact semantics of the lookup tables byte_5B82F8, byte_5B83F8 and byte_5B84F8 (distance base, extra bits, length base) are DERIVED in the existing analysis, not confirmed by the raw source.
